statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-55453 (GHSA-7hqf-mfhx-7r3v): before CUPS 2.4.20, quote_string() in the IPP backend (backend/ipp.c) keeps carriage-return and line-feed characters from a remote printer's marker message, so the printer can inject lines into the status stream that the scheduler reads, including a PPD: line that changes the queue's PPD. The upstream fix replaces every control character and DEL with a space in quote_string(): https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/security/advisories/GHSA-7hqf-mfhx-7r3v and commit d41cf0616688721e9d435d54118c4c8a36ed596a on the 2.4.x branch, first released in 2.4.20: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/d41cf0616688721e9d435d54118c4c8a36ed596a. We downloaded every package built from the cups source in the Alpine 3.23 index of the DHI Alpine repository, for x86_64 and aarch64 (cups, cups-client, cups-dbg, cups-dev, cups-doc, cups-lang, cups-libs, cups-openrc and ipptool at 2.4.13-r0, 2.4.16-r0, 2.4.18-r0 and 2.4.18-r1; 72 apks), checked each against its index checksum, and disassembled quote_string() in /usr/lib/cups/backend/ipp using the symbol table in cups-dbg. In 2.4.13-r0, 2.4.16-r0 and 2.4.18-r0 quote_string() copies each byte without testing for control characters. In 2.4.18-r1, on both architectures, it tests each byte for a control character (below 0x20) or DEL (0x7f) and writes a space instead, which is the upstream fix; 2.4.18-r1 is the first build that carries it.

CVE-2026-55453 (GHSA-7hqf-mfhx-7r3v): before CUPS 2.4.20, quote_string() in the IPP backend (backend/ipp.c) keeps carriage-return and line-feed characters from a remote printer's marker message, so the printer can inject lines into the status stream that the scheduler reads, including a PPD: line that changes the queue's PPD. The upstream fix replaces every control character and DEL with a space in quote_string(): https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/security/advisories/GHSA-7hqf-mfhx-7r3v and commit d41cf0616688721e9d435d54118c4c8a36ed596a on the 2.4.x branch, first released in 2.4.20: https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/d41cf0616688721e9d435d54118c4c8a36ed596a. We downloaded every package built from the cups source in the DHI Debian repository for trixie, amd64 and arm64, including the -dbgsym packages: 22 binary packages in each of the four published DHI builds of 2.4.10-3+deb13u2, the fifth to the eighth (176 debs), each checked against its index checksum; the earlier DHI builds are no longer published. Debian lists the CVE as open for trixie, with no fixed version, at https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-55453, so its own 2.4.10-3+deb13u2 packages serve as the unfixed comparison. We disassembled quote_string() in /usr/lib/cups/backend/ipp (cups-daemon) in the DHI builds and in Debian's packages, using the symbol tables in the -dbgsym packages. Debian's quote_string() copies each byte without testing for control characters. In every published DHI build on both architectures, quote_string() tests each byte for DEL (0x7f) and control characters and writes a space instead, which is the upstream fix backported to 2.4.10. The lowest published DHI build, the fifth, already carries it, so every published build is fixed.
